[AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), choose up to one of your opponent's front row rear-guards, return it to hand, [COST][Soul-Blast 1 card with "Siana" in its card name or trigger unit], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn for each of your opponent's open front row (RC).
[AUTO](RC):When your grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Siana" in its card name attacks, if your opponent's front row has no rear-guards, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and [Stand] this unit.

[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, perform one of the following.
・If it is rode upon by a grade 3 <CoroCoro>  , draw a card, choose a card from your hand, and bind it.
・If it is rode upon by a grade 3 card with "Grandpa" in its card name, draw two cards, choose a card from your hand, and bind it.
